# #2930: Patch: card tests use the crate's scenario helper instead of registering the catalog before every scenario
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

The card tests repeat the same setup line about 2,240 times: each test registers every card and then builds its scenario, although the cards crate already has a helper that does both. The rules tests also copy the same small helper functions into dozens of files.

Once this is built, those copies are gone. That is about 2,000 fewer lines of test code that behave exactly as before, so the files bots and people read are shorter, and the repository's existing check stops the copies from coming back.

## Why

- **The setup line is repeated about 2,240 times.**
  - `crates/cards/src/lib.rs:212-217` defines `pub(crate) fn scenario(opts)`, which runs `register_all()` and then the testkit's `scenario`.
  - Card scripts' tests still write `crate::register_all();` on the line directly before a `scenario(` call 2,240 times: `grep -A1 'register_all();' crates/cards/src/scripts | grep -c 'scenario('`.
  - In 53 files, 215 of those lines sit in modules that already import `crate::scenario`, so they register twice. For example, `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c021_moonberry.rs` lines 45, 67-68 and 78-79.
- **Rules tests copy the harness's helpers.**
  - `crates/engine/tests/rules/fixtures/harness.rs:140` has `ids_of`, yet 46 test files across the engine's rules tests, the cards and the AI each define their own `fn ids(cards: &[CardInstance]) -> Vec<String>`.
  - 28 rules files define their own `fn input(` and 18 their own `fn by(`.
- **The existing check cannot see them.** `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs:971` (`SHARED_TEST_HELPERS`) already refuses local copies of named harness helpers. It matches by name only and has no row for these.
- **Precedent.** #2759 cut comments and long names to reduce the token footprint; this cuts repeated code for the same reason.

## Proposal

1. In each card script's test module, add `use crate::scenario;` and drop the `crate::register_all();` that sits on the line before a `scenario(` call. A test that registers for any other reason keeps its call.
2. Move the most common form of `input` and `by` into `harness.rs`, switch the `ids` copies to `ids_of`, and delete the local copies.
3. Add the moved names to the harness row of `SHARED_TEST_HELPERS`. Add a check that no card script's test calls `register_all();` on the line before `scenario(`.
4. Change no assertion: every test keeps its name and what it checks.

## Where it lands

- `crates/cards/src/scripts/**` (test modules only), `crates/engine/tests/rules/**`, `crates/engine/tests/rules/fixtures/harness.rs`, and the AI tests that copy `ids`.
- `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs`.
- CLAUDE.md rule 6: each card's tests stay in its own file.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No card script calls `register_all();` on the line before a `scenario(` call, and the acceptance test fails on one.
- [ ] No rules, cards or AI test file defines its own copy of `ids`, `input` or `by`, and the acceptance test fails on one.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` and `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*'` run the same number of tests before and after.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo jackioh spec check` pass.

## Size and risks

Large by file count (several hundred card scripts and about 70 rules files) but mechanical; that makes it hard by CLAUDE.md rule 11's 40-file mark. The risk is merge conflicts with card pull requests in flight. It can land in a quiet window or be split by set. A test whose `by` or `input` differs from the common form keeps its local helper under its own name.

## Risks

- **Silent loss of registration.** The isolated run covers it. Each of the 2,240 lines after a dropped register calls `scenario(`, `crate::scenario(`, or a local `*_scenario(` helper that calls `scenario(`; all of these now resolve to the crate's.
- **Merge conflicts with card PRs in flight.** The edit is mechanical: after merging `main`, rerun the step 2 script and step 7, and fix any new copy the acceptance test names. A card PR written from the old template fails the new test and needs its register line dropped; the updated ADDING_CARDS.md says so.
- **Imports.** A module whose tests used the testkit glob only for `scenario` now fails `unused_imports` (step 3's six). If clippy names another one after a merge, delete that glob the same way; never add an `#[allow]`.
- **Name-only check.** Like every existing row, the check refuses a copy by its name. A helper whose body differs takes another name (step 6) rather than an exception.

## Risks

- **Silent loss of registration.** The isolated run covers it. Each of the 2,240 lines after a dropped register calls `scenario(`, `crate::scenario(`, or a local `*_scenario(` helper that calls `scenario(`; all of these now resolve to the crate's.
- **Merge conflicts with card PRs in flight.** The edit is mechanical: after merging `main`, rerun the step 2 script and step 7, and fix any new copy the acceptance test names. A card PR written from the old template fails the new test and needs its register line dropped; the updated ADDING_CARDS.md says so.
- **Imports.** A module whose tests used the testkit glob only for `scenario` now fails `unused_imports` (step 3's six). If clippy names another one after a merge, delete that glob the same way; never add an `#[allow]`.
- **Name-only check.** Like every existing row, the check refuses a copy by its name. A helper whose body differs takes another name (step 6) rather than an exception.
